label: About
title: About Painted Terminal Séance
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 526 recent saved-signal files and 173 captured links, then narrowed the page to 6 source windows around multithread - Aksioma and @trq212: a prompt I've been using a lot recently: implement <SPEC> and while you do, keep a..., plus 4 more. A source image from i.ytimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Painted Terminal Séance: Painted terminal séance in a poster-crop composition, side-lit object slab grammar: one severe dusty pastel-black field holds an oversized cropped dark monitor-glass relic, with cassette-label slits, IBM-cream fold cuts, ink panel scars, lavender sprite notches, and glyph pinholes set only on edges and repairs. Spar... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 6 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against cyan CRT glass bloom and ribbed scan surface, scarred black left bezel seam, and thin purple cassette-label slit.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
